text:
sam: Heads-up — we just rolled the new INT8 kernel selector and are seeing a ~15% P95 regression on AWQ weight-only across our chat workload. Notebooks + smoke benches both. Repro steps below.

maria: ugh. seen any signal whether it's packing or kernel switch?

sam: suspect packing overlap with group-size=32 heuristic. When selector prefers the new 'lane-parallel' kernel for groups <=32, packing overhead spikes due to extra memcpy + alignment. Quick bench: 
```
# bench command (micro): ./bench --model redwood-awq-3b --quant awq --group 32 --seq 1024 --clients 8
# results (before -> after selector change):
P50 12.4ms -> 13.9ms
P95 28.7ms -> 33.1ms
tokens/s 425 -> 372
CPU memcpy cycles up ~18%
```

lucas: can you try disabling group packing locally (fall back to serial pack) to confirm?

sam: did that. when packing disabled, P95 returns close to baseline (29.1ms). So packing path interacting badly with lane-parallel kernel.

jia: might be KV cache eviction patterns — lane-parallel assumes contiguous KV layout; our packer scatters small groups across lanes which increases cache misses. Can we get perf counters (L1/L2 miss) from the infra profiler?

sam: attached a condensed perf snippet from the repro VM: 
```
Mode: lane-parallel + packed grp32
L1d miss rate: 4.2% (was 2.1%)
L2 miss rate: 1.8% (was 0.9%)
memcpy throughput drop: -12%
Context switch negligible
```

maria: interesting — calibration also matters. Did we re-run the per-layer scale calibration for grp32 after kernel change? Kernel math ordering changed slightly which shifts rounding. Could be different activation ranges and triggers extra dequant ops.

lucas: action plan: 1) add a fast-path in selector: if group<=32 && packing enabled -> prefer serial pack kernel, 2) add telemetry flag to log pack scatter density, 3) run group-size sweep (8,16,32,64) with KV hit/miss counters.

jia: I'll run the sweep on the staging pool. Also include seq length 256/1024/2048 to catch calibration drift.

infra-bot: Scheduling job: sweep-2812345678 on staging-gpu-7, ETA 18m.

ci-bot: CI note — reverting selector landing in canary until perf fix is validated.

sam: thanks. if sweep shows L1 miss scaling with pack density we'll either change pack layout to contiguous-by-lane or tweak kernel to accept packed strides. Prefer layout change if it avoids memcpy.

maria: agreed. also add a calibration regression test for grp=32 to the nightly perf suite. small net but catches subtle fp/quantic shifts.

lucas: leaving a TODO in the runtime ticket: add pack_density metric, kernel_pref heuristics, and a perf-test entry for AWQ-weightonly grp32.

sam: I'll post the sweep results in this thread when ready. Thanks all.
